title: Mobile Car Detailing in Chemainus: Salt Air, Mural Town Charm, and a Clean Car at Your Door
metaDescription: Mobile car detailing in Chemainus, BC. We come to your home or work with exterior, interior, and full detail packages from $79. Call 250-709-1371 for a free quote.
excerpt: Chemainus vehicles take a beating from salt air off the harbour and grime from the highway. Here's what a mobile detail looks like for residents near the murals and ferry terminal.

content.text: Chemainus is known for its murals, its harbour, and the ferry terminal that shuttles residents and visitors out to Thetis and Penelakut Islands. It's also a town where vehicles quietly take more abuse than owners realize. Between the salt-laden air off the water, log truck traffic on Highway 1 and Chemainus Road, and the fine grit that blows in from the mill and rail yard, cars parked outside in Chemainus accumulate grime and corrosion risk faster than vehicles further inland in Duncan or Cobble Hill.
Why Chemainus Cars Need Detailing More Often

Salt air is the big one. If you're anywhere near Water Wheel Park, Kin Park, or the ferry dock, airborne salt settles on paint, chrome, and exposed metal daily. Left alone, it accelerates oxidation on clear coat and speeds up rust on wheel wells, exhaust tips, and undercarriage hardware. Add in brake dust and diesel soot from log trucks working the Chemainus corridor, and you get a film that regular hand washing at home often just smears around instead of removing. We see it constantly on trucks and SUVs that commute between Chemainus and Duncan for work.
What We Bring to Your Driveway

We're fully mobile, which matters in a town like Chemainus where a lot of residents are a 15 to 20 minute drive from the nearest detail shop in Duncan or Nanaimo. We bring our own water, power, and products, and work right at your home, workplace, or even the marina parking area if that's more convenient. No appointment across town, no dropping the car off for a full day.

Full Detail from $179 (sedan) / $209 (SUV) / $239 (truck) - the complete exterior and interior package, our most popular option for Chemainus customers who want the salt air damage addressed both inside and out

content.text: For vehicles that live near the water full-time, we recommend a protective sealant or ceramic-boosted wax rather than a basic wax alone. It creates a more durable barrier between the paint and salt spray, and it makes the next wash easier since grime has less to grip onto. Customers who book a detail every 8 to 10 weeks through the wetter months tend to keep their paint and chrome looking noticeably better than those who wait until spring to deal with a winter's worth of buildup.
Booking a Mobile Detail in Chemainus

We regularly serve Chemainus alongside Ladysmith, Crofton, and the rest of the Cowichan Valley, so scheduling around the ferry traffic or a work shift at the mill isn't a problem. Most exterior details take 1.5 to 2 hours, interior details run similar, and a full detail typically takes 3 to 4 hours depending on vehicle size and condition. All we need is access to a driveway or parking spot and a nearby outlet.

If your car, truck, or SUV in Chemainus is due for a wash that actually cuts through salt film and road grime, call or text 250-709-1371 for a free, no-obligation quote. We'll ask a few quick questions about your vehicle and get you booked in at a time that works.
